$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Auto-Archive settings (plans/cmux-next/auto-archive-DESIGN.md): how idle workspaces leave the way. gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants (AutoArchiveSettings parses them). Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: autoArchive
lists.note: Settings > General > Auto-Archive. AutoArchiveCoordinator (CmuxNextApp) reads both rows; a group's own rule (Auto-Archive in its right-click menu, extra.auto_archive) wins over idleDays.

rows.name: style
rows.note: manual by default (Lawrence 18515/18517: the Tidy Up card popping up on its own was annoying): nothing runs in the background and nothing pops up; Archive Idle Workspaces (palette, sidebar menu) archives on request. suggest shows the Tidy Up card; quiet archives on its own with an Undo toast (the card's Always Archive picks it); groups only archives in groups that set their own rule; off never.

help.text: What cmux does with workspaces you have not used for a while. Archived workspaces stay in their group, dimmed and last, and come back when you open them.

choices.note: A sidebar card lists the idle workspaces; Archive archives them, Not Now waits a day.
Idle workspaces archive on their own; a toast says how many, with Undo.

title.text: Only in Groups With a Rule

choices.note: Only members of groups whose Auto-Archive is set archive on their own (with Undo); everything else stays.
Nothing runs in the background; Archive Idle Workspaces (palette, sidebar menu) archives them at once.
No card, no automatic archive; group rules are ignored. Archive Idle Workspaces still works.

rows.name: idleDays
rows.note: Days since the workspace was last shown, typed in or printed output, or its agent spoke. 3 days: a long weekend away does not count as done. A group's own rule wins.

help.text: A workspace counts as idle when you have not opened it and nothing in it changed for this many days. Pinned workspaces, running commands and workspaces that need you never archive.
